plugins.name: rampwise
plugins.description: Rampwise: an AI coach for triathletes, runners, cyclists and swimmers, for your Garmin data or a few numbers you type. Evidence-labelled plans for 17 events (5K to Ironman, duathlon, cycling, open-water swimming), daily adaptation, injury-risk watch and reports. Independent project, not affiliated with Garmin. Experimental.
